_comment: Single source of truth for the segment list. DESIGN.md fixes these six
lowercase strings and states the list changes only by decision of the
design lead. HubSpot routing depends on them, so they are never edited
to suit a page. tools/check.mjs reads this file and fails any page whose
chip rows, router or data-segment attributes disagree with it.
'built' marks which segments have their own landing page. 'deferred'
segments keep their chip and still capture a labelled lead, they just
have no page of their own yet.
SCOPE SET 13 Aug 2026: four pages, home first as the template.
prestige and expat deferred.
FOLDERS 13 Aug 2026: pages live under 'New Builds/', two levels below the
repository root. The 'home' segment builds into the 'buyer' folder, so its
key and its folder name differ on purpose. The key is the routing label
and never changes; the folder is only a path. Every other segment builds
into a folder named after its key.
REBUILD 17 Aug 2026: the first home buyers page was rejected by the
client, deleted (recoverable at d5251d3) and rebuilt the same day from
the Paper.Design artboard 'BUYER 1440'. For this design Paper is the
visual source of truth; the token deltas against Figma are recorded in
HANDOVER.md. The rebuilt page is the template for the other three.

segments.label: Home buyer
segments.register: Reassuring, process-forward. Lead with handover of risk and the fact that a person inspects everything. Do not lead with data.

segments.label: Investor
segments.register: Evidence-forward. Lead with independence and no developer commissions.

segments.label: Commercial
segments.register: Competent, transactional. Lead with due diligence and buy-versus-lease certainty.

segments.label: Prestige
segments.register: Restrained, fewer words, more space. Lead with access to stock that never reaches the market.

segments.label: Expat
segments.register: Practical. Lead with the remote process and current foreign buyer rules.

segments.label: Developer
segments.register: Numerical. Lead with site access and resale numbers, shortest copy of any segment.

deferredChipBehaviour.assumed: Keep prestige and expat chips in every router and chip row. They select normally and post to the same capture form, so the lead still arrives labelled in HubSpot. No page, no outbound link, no dead click.
deferredChipBehaviour.alternative: Link the two chips out to the equivalent propertybuyer.com.au pages instead. Costs the labelled lead.

segmentRanking.problem: DESIGN.md says not all six can get equal treatment or nothing ranks. Every page gives all six equal weight, which the rules call wrong.
segmentRanking.status: RESOLVED 13 Aug 2026, equal weight is deliberate
segmentRanking.decision: Do not rank. The client database was never set up to qualify leads or segment the market, so there is no evidence base to rank against. Ranking now would encode a guess as a design decision. These pages exist partly to generate that evidence: every capture point labels a lead by segment, budget band and location, and the distribution that comes back is the ranking input.
segmentRanking.consequence: The router is a measurement instrument before it is a conversion device. Revisit once there is real volume, and rank on observed demand rather than assumption.
segmentRanking.supersedes: The DESIGN.md rule that equal treatment is itself wrong. That rule assumes you know the order. Here, not knowing is the finding.

tier1Proof.problem: The rules budget three Tier 1 proof blocks per page, attributable and dated. No real examples were supplied, and the slots shipped empty.
tier1Proof.status: RESOLVED for home 18 Aug 2026, nine still outstanding
tier1Proof.decision: The home page slots were filled 18 Aug 2026 from the client-supplied deck "Latest Recent Purchases - Commercial.pdf". Every figure is copied from that deck rather than derived, and each of the three traces to a row in paper/proof-register.md. The page now carries no proof brackets; the three that remain are footer legal links.
tier1Proof.openQuestion: The deck is commercial and this is the home buyers page, so the three slots put commercial purchases in front of a residential audience. Done at the client's direction. The figures are sound, the audience is not settled, and these three are the natural content for the commercial page when it is built. The displaced residential rows are kept under Reserves in the register so the page can be reverted without re-research.
tier1Proof.safeguard: Unfilled values stay wrapped in square brackets, so an unfilled slot renders as visibly unfilled rather than as a plausible claim. tools/check.mjs used to fail hard on any bracket in visible copy; that rule was retired 18 Aug 2026 at the client's direction, because the values arrive after the proof of concept and a permanent failure on every run was drowning out the checks that still matter. The brackets remain the safeguard, the automated stop does not.
tier1Proof.outstanding: Nine real proof points still needed, three each for investor, commercial and developer. Each one needs a number, a location, a month and year, and a client name.

proyaleCase.problem: Proyale is capitals-only, so H1 and H2 render in caps whatever case is typed, against a sentence case rule with no exceptions.
proyaleCase.decision: A font limitation, not a contradiction. The sentence case rule governs how copy is written, not how a chosen display face renders it. No text-transform anywhere, and headings stay written in sentence case so the Georgia fallback renders correctly before Proyale loads.
